hint.zh: 任取一个 a，假设它是猫，一路套用下去。
hint.en: Take any a, assume it is a cat, and apply all the way.

t.zh: 写《爱丽丝漫游奇境》的刘易斯·卡罗尔是一位逻辑学家。他编过许多推理题：几句「都是」「都不是」「有的」，要推出一句结论。
t.en: Lewis Carroll, author of Alice in Wonderland, was a logician. He made many reasoning puzzles: a few sentences of “all”, “no” and “some”, from which a conclusion must be drawn.

t.zh: 最简单的一种是亚里士多德的三段论：「A 都是 B，B 都是 C，所以 A 都是 C」。
t.en: The simplest kind is Aristotle’s syllogism: “all A are B, all B are C, so all A are C”.

after.zh: 两千多年里，三段论几乎就是逻辑的全部。
after.en: For over two thousand years the syllogism was nearly all of logic.
